pages.text: Mirage blocks come in mostly four varieties: Grass, Sand, Netherrack and Endstone. They can only be harvested with Silk Touch from $(l:offsprings/maw)$(c)$(o)Gorger Traps$(). Similarly to Powdered Snow, these blocks can be walked on when wearing Leather or $(l:armors/skin_armor)$(c)$(o)Skin boots$(). Using maps is a reliable way to differentiate Mirage Blocks, as they do not appear on them.
